identity.mechanic: Wading: minions that can't be attacked until they attack.

keywords.name: Wade
keywords.text: Can't be attacked until it attacks. After it attacks, it stops Wading.

identity.plays: Your herons sit out of reach until they strike. You decide each turn who wades and who stands in the open.
